cases.name: url-encode-mixed
cases.covers: A name-only entry, a scalar, a multi-select repeating its name, and an empty multi-select; UTF-8 percent encoding of everything outside the unreserved set.

cases.name: incomplete-tree-is-refused
cases.covers: Never execute an incomplete tree, not even its root; canExecute agrees.

cases.name: rootless-tree-is-inert
cases.covers: A tree with no root is inert and counted; canExecute is false.

cases.name: walks-next-in-pdf-order
cases.covers: Root then /Next depth-first, with the child-index path of every node.

cases.name: executed-then-failed-is-partial
cases.covers: An executed node beside a failed one folds to partial.

cases.name: defers-navigation-and-external-effects
cases.covers: goto, then javascript, then uri in PDF order: document work runs inline and the navigation and URI thunks fire after it, in node order.

cases.name: a-document-failure-drops-deferred-work
cases.covers: A failed document node skips later document nodes (javascript, reset-form, hide) and drops every deferred thunk; the result is partial.

cases.name: policy-matrix-defaults
cases.covers: The default rows: a lifecycle uri reports, a hover submit blocks, a lifecycle Print blocks, launch and the other fixed types are never executable, recognized types without an interpreter and unknown types are no-executor; canExecute mirrors the root decision.

cases.name: a-print-typed-node-uses-the-print-row
cases.covers: A node whose type is literally "print" finds policy.print by key, and with no executor is no-executor.

cases.name: policy-overrides
cases.covers: config.policy rows replace the defaults: block and report refuse with their names, allow executes even for a lifecycle uri.

cases.name: policy-rows-merge-and-update-live
cases.covers: config.policy merges row-wise over the defaults (a partial row keeps the other origins); getPolicy is the effective policy; updatePolicy merges rows over the current policy, skips an empty row, bumps policyRevision even for an empty patch, and later dispatches decide with it.

cases.name: execute-named
cases.covers: executeNamed runs one Named verb as a user-origin api action through the same queue; a partial context overrides the origin, source or event; Print goes through the adapter door.

cases.name: get-action-tree
cases.covers: getActionTree reads the raw tree behind each source kind: an annotation (activate by default, or the named /AA event; the /A-shadows-U rule is not applied), a field by object number (not the first numbered field) or by name, a page (open by default, or close, visible or invisible), and the catalog (OpenAction by default, or the Table-200 tree for a verb). Anything absent is null, and a document without the actions service has no catalog trees.
cases.reason: Pins what the dispatcher answers: read trees, refusals, and which installed sink or resolver is current, through call outcomes, adapter callbacks and engine calls. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: uri-without-an-adapter
cases.covers: A user uri with no adapter installed is no-executor with a no-adapter diagnostic.

cases.name: named-print-goes-to-the-adapter
cases.covers: The Named Print verb reaches the adapter with no context, never the named executor; other named verbs use the executor.

cases.name: print-refusals
cases.covers: Print with no adapter is no-executor; print without doc.print authority is blocked before the adapter.
cases.reason: Pins what the dispatcher answers: read trees, refusals, and which installed sink or resolver is current, through call outcomes, adapter callbacks and engine calls. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: hide-routes-by-plane
cases.covers: A hide name resolves to its field (form setDisplay), a widget object number to its owning field, and a plain object number to an annotation flag patch; the form plane commits first.

cases.name: hide-and-later-document-work
cases.covers: An executed hide leaves later document nodes running; a failed hide skips them.

cases.name: hide-without-targets
cases.covers: A hide with no targets reads nothing and executes.

cases.name: hide-reports-honestly
cases.covers: Missing sinks are no-executor, an unresolved name is a diagnostic (the node still executes), an annotation refusal fails the node only when every entry failed, and a failure without an error string executes.

cases.name: hide-form-failures
cases.covers: A form sink failure (with an error message, or a bare rejected status) fails the node and skips the annotation plane.

cases.name: hide-sink-throws
cases.covers: A sink that throws synchronously inside hide is not caught by the dispatcher: execute rejects and nothing is counted.

cases.name: hide-forms-read-rejects
cases.covers: A forms.list rejection inside hide rejects execute.

cases.name: document-executors
cases.covers: reset-form and javascript without an executor (javascript is inert, "scripting unavailable"); an executor that is inert, fails, throws, rejects, or answers later.

cases.name: navigation-executors
cases.covers: Deferred goto/named: no executor, inert, throws, rejects, executed.

cases.name: executors-are-last-wins-and-identity-safe
cases.covers: A duplicate registration replaces the executor with a duplicate-executor diagnostic; a stale disposer leaves the successor; the current disposer removes it.

cases.name: adapter-is-identity-safe
cases.covers: A stale adapter disposer leaves the successor; the current one clears it; setUiAdapter(null) force-clears.

cases.name: sinks-and-resolver-are-identity-safe
cases.covers: Commit sinks, the submit resolver and the submit handler all install last-wins and clear only while current.
cases.reason: Pins what the dispatcher answers: read trees, refusals, and which installed sink or resolver is current, through call outcomes, adapter callbacks and engine calls. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: dispatches-serialize
cases.covers: One queue: a slow execute holds the next until it settles, and the counter advances once per dispatch.

cases.name: hooks-deliver-and-isolate
cases.covers: onAction carries ctx, tree and result; a throwing observer is reported to the host sink and its siblings still run; an unsubscribed listener hears nothing.

cases.name: a-user-execute-arms-the-open-sequence
cases.covers: Under auto, a user-origin execute runs the open sequence ahead of itself; a hover execute does not arm it.

cases.name: payload-less-submit-is-inert
cases.covers: An older-runtime SubmitForm with no payload is recognized-inert with its own diagnostic.

cases.name: no-resolver
cases.covers: Without a dataset resolver every submit blocks with no-submit-resolver.

cases.name: resolver-failures
cases.covers: A resolver that throws or rejects fails the node with the dataset-resolution diagnostic.

cases.name: no-sink
cases.covers: With a resolver but no handler and no submit-capable home, the submit blocks with no-submit-sink.

cases.name: the-document-home
cases.covers: The home is awaited with the request shape it expects (charSet only when present, the clock for clientTimeMs); a refusal fails the node.

cases.name: the-home-uses-the-configured-clock
cases.covers: clientTimeMs comes from javascript.now when configured, even with scripting disabled.

cases.name: a-handler-beats-the-home
cases.covers: An installed handler receives the request and a home delegate (or null without a home); synchronous acceptance executes and the home never auto-fires.
cases.reason: Pins the handoff between an installed submit handler and the home, through the handler callbacks and the engine calls. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: handler-contract
cases.covers: A synchronous throw fails the node; a returned promise is detached: resolving says nothing, rejecting emits a diagnostic later and never rewrites the node.

cases.name: submit-policy
cases.covers: A lifecycle submit is blocked by default; a policy row of allow or adapter admits it, and report or block refuse.

cases.name: submit-is-deferred-behind-document-work
cases.covers: A submit before a failing document node never fires.

cases.name: activate-resolves-the-annotation-tree
cases.covers: An activate trigger finds its annotation by ref (object number, /NM on the same page, index on the same page) and runs /A; mismatched kinds, pages or indexes find nothing.

cases.name: annotation-events-resolve-their-aa-tree
cases.covers: Each of the six /AA pointer events resolves its own tree; absence is silently inert; the hover pair is hover-origin and the rest are user-origin.

cases.name: a-source-hint-is-provenance-only
cases.covers: A first-party source hint becomes the step source, and the origin is still derived from the trigger.

cases.name: a-precedes-aa-u
cases.covers: /A shadows the /AA U tree: a mouseUp on an annotation with /A is inert; without /A its U tree runs.

cases.name: an-incomplete-trigger-tree-is-refused
cases.covers: A rootless but incomplete tree still becomes a step, and the step is refused; the trigger folds to refused.

cases.name: resolution-never-rejects
cases.covers: A failed annotation read and an unknown page both come back refused with trigger-failed; dispatch never rejects.

cases.name: submission-order-is-execution-order
cases.covers: Two dispatches run in call order even when the first read is slower.

cases.name: page-fan-out-order
cases.covers: open runs page /O then the /PO set; close runs the /PC set then /C; visible and invisible fan only their sets; rootless trees and tree-less annotations are no steps.

cases.name: a-failed-step-never-skips-its-siblings
cases.covers: A /PC step that fails is partial; the page /C still runs, and the trigger folds to partial.

cases.name: single-tree-lifecycle-annotations
cases.covers: An annotation bearing only one lifecycle tree (close, visible or invisible) is still in the lifecycle set.

cases.name: an-all-inert-fan-out-is-inert
cases.covers: Steps that all come back inert fold to inert.

cases.name: deferred-navigation-flushes-per-step
cases.covers: A page /O goto fires inside its own step, before the /PO step runs.

cases.name: lifecycle-cache-and-invalidation
cases.covers: Lifecycle trees are read once per page; any annotation.* event and stream.desynced clear the cache, other events do not; close unsubscribes.
cases.reason: Pins when lifecycle trees are read and which trigger families fire, through the engine reads and the dispatch outcomes. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: trigger-gates
cases.covers: Disabled families are inert with trigger-disabled and canDispatch false; activate is never gated.

cases.name: gates-default-open
cases.covers: A triggers object with no families set leaves every family enabled.
cases.reason: Pins when lifecycle trees are read and which trigger families fire, through the engine reads and the dispatch outcomes. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: auto-fires-ahead-of-the-first-user-dispatch
cases.covers: The first user-origin dispatch arms the sequence before taking its own queue slot.

cases.name: open-sequence-completed-event
cases.covers: onOpenSequenceCompleted fires once with the folded sequence result after the document steps; a throwing listener is reported to the host sink and never stops its siblings.

cases.name: auto-a-submit-handler-does-not-arm
cases.covers: Installing a submit handler is not the latch release: nothing runs until an adapter arrives.

cases.name: headless-falls-back-to-the-first-page
cases.covers: headless fires at bring-up; with no stage report the initial page open is the first page.

cases.name: headless-with-a-report
cases.covers: headless with a buffered report opens the reported page instead of the first.

cases.name: headless-with-no-pages
cases.covers: headless on a document with no pages releases the barrier and opens nothing.

cases.name: off-releases-the-barrier
cases.covers: off never runs the sequence but a report emits straight away.

cases.name: a-replayed-open-trigger
cases.covers: A document-open trigger after the sequence fired reports open-sequence-replayed; before it fired, it runs the sequence.

cases.name: open-sequence-read-fails
cases.covers: A failed catalog read inside the sequence is a trigger-failed diagnostic; the barrier still releases and a later report emits.

cases.name: no-actions-service
cases.covers: A document without the actions service reads as no catalog: the sequence has no steps.

cases.name: coordinator-diffs
cases.covers: Unplaced reports are ignored; a placed report emits close(old), invisible, visible, open(new); a report with no change emits nothing; a current page of null closes without opening.

cases.name: cascade-budget
cases.covers: Consecutive programmatic rounds past the cap are suppressed with a cascade-budget diagnostic (state still tracked); a user-caused report resets the count.

cases.name: cascade-budget-resets-on-user-activity
cases.covers: A user-origin dispatch resets the cascade count, and so does a user report while the barrier is closed.

cases.name: the-five-catalog-trees
cases.covers: Each verb-shaped document event resolves its Table-200 tree through dispatch; a missing tree is inert.

cases.name: missing-trees-are-inert
cases.covers: A catalog without the tree, or with a rootless one, is inert.

cases.name: open-runs-before-the-first-document-event
cases.covers: Under auto with the latch still armed, a first will-save runs the OpenAction inline first; the sequence then counts as fired.

cases.name: a-rejected-catalog-read-is-evicted
cases.covers: A rejected catalog read degrades to trigger-failed and is evicted, so the next event reads again.

cases.name: document-family-disabled
cases.covers: triggers.document false: runDocumentVerb skips both trees and still runs the operation; dispatch of a document event is trigger-disabled.

cases.name: prepare-close
cases.covers: prepareClose runs the will-close tree through the dispatch door.

cases.name: run-document-verb-serializes
cases.covers: Two concurrent save verbs never interleave: the second waits for the first operation and its did-save.

cases.name: run-document-verb-failure-laws
cases.covers: A failing will-save never cancels the operation; an operation that throws or rejects skips did-save and rethrows.

cases.name: run-document-verb-print-holds-the-latch
cases.covers: The print verb holds the print latch for its whole body: a Named Print inside will-print is suppressed as reentrant, and the latch is released after.

cases.name: print-verb-runs-wp-adapter-dp
cases.covers: A Named Print runs will-print, the adapter exactly once, then did-print; a Print nested in will-print is suppressed with reentrant-print.

cases.name: an-adapter-throw-skips-did-print
cases.covers: An adapter print that throws rejects execute and skips did-print; the latch resets, so a later print works.

cases.name: adapter-uninstalled-mid-print
cases.covers: An adapter cleared while will-print runs leaves the print no-executor, without did-print.

cases.name: an-open-uri-throw-rejects-execute
cases.covers: An adapter openUri that throws rejects execute; the counter does not move.

cases.name: a-script-node-is-one-transaction
cases.covers: The javascript executor prefetches the page world (fields, script-addressable annots with their styles and defaults), boots the name tree once, runs the node with Field x Mouse Up and the target value, and commits form effects then annotation effects.

cases.name: script-effects-commit
cases.covers: Form effects reach the form sink and annotation effects the annotation sink (object-number refs with their page, other refs as -1 without one).

cases.name: script-commit-failures
cases.covers: No form sink drops form effects with no-commit-sink; a form failure skips the annotation effects; no annotation sink drops them; an annotation failure fails the node.

cases.name: boot-effects-and-a-refetched-world
cases.covers: A boot that stages effects commits them in the first transaction, surfaces its UI effects as phase boot, and the run sees a refetched world; later nodes do not boot again.

cases.name: boot-without-effects
cases.covers: A boot output with nothing to commit does not refetch the world.

cases.name: run-errors-and-diagnostics
cases.covers: A run error fails the node with its message, after its diagnostics and error reach the script hooks; its effects are not committed.

cases.name: external-effects-run-after-the-transaction
cases.covers: print and submitForm UI effects from boot and run are held back and fired after the transaction (print through will-print/adapter/did-print, submit through the sink chain); alert and gotoPage surface inline.

cases.name: script-print-obeys-the-print-policy
cases.covers: A script's print() is gated by the print policy row for the dispatch origin: under the defaults a lifecycle script's print is blocked before the adapter, and a user script's still prints.

cases.name: script-node-budget
cases.covers: maxScriptNodesPerDispatch caps JS nodes per dispatch: the rest are inert with the budget reason, and the next dispatch starts a fresh count.

cases.name: script-event-provenance
cases.covers: event.type and event.name from the trigger provenance: Field, Link, Annot, Page, Doc, and every annotation, page and document event name; a widget target by object number or name, with a value only for a scalar.

cases.name: no-page-to-anchor

cases.name: viewer-only-page-cache
cases.covers: Without the annotation plugin linksOn reads the engine-backed cache (empty until loaded). ensurePage lists the page once, keeps visible links with a target (hidden and noView dropped, invisible kept), ids obj: refs by object number and every other ref by page and index, converts the rect through the page crop, copies a truthy activate tree, flags hover events from either cursor root, and marks group children attached. A loaded page, or one the document does not have, asks nothing.

cases.name: viewer-only-malformed-lists
cases.covers: A list the fulfilled handler throws on (no annotations member, a null entry, a link without flags, ref or rect) caches nothing; a non-link without flags is skipped before flags are read. A missing index prints as undefined in the id and a rect without edges converts to NaN.

cases.name: viewer-only-loads-in-flight
cases.covers: A second ensureLoaded while a list is in flight joins it (v2 listed the page again). A refused list leaves the page unloaded, so the next ensureLoaded retries.

cases.name: viewer-only-refetch-on-events
cases.covers: Created, updated, moved (by its first entry) and deleted annotation events refetch a cached page; an empty move, an uncached page and any other event ask nothing. Closing the document releases the subscription.

cases.name: annotation-backed-source
cases.covers: With the annotation plugin linksOn is its folded model (hidden links excluded, no engine read), ensurePage defers to it, and annotation events never make this plugin fetch: the cache stays empty.

A point right of every link, or below every link, answers null.

cases.name: labels-and-resolution
cases.covers: getLabel reads a Link’s target or a bare target: the uri, a fixed goto label, the name, and Link for anything else. resolve has no side effect: a goto to a page of the document resolves to a reveal with its page index and options, one to a page the document lacks to its destination, uri and named to their member, and the rest to reported.

cases.name: list-all-links-and-loaded-events
cases.covers: Without the annotation plugin isLoaded follows the cache; listAllLinks loads every page and answers their links in page order; onLoaded fires for each page that loaded (not for a refused read) and again when an annotation event refetches a cached page.

cases.name: list-all-links-annotation-backed

cases.name: set-replaces-a-page
cases.covers: setPage replaces the page and keeps the others.

cases.name: drop-an-empty-page
cases.covers: A page cached with no links is still present, so dropping it makes a new state.

cases.name: drop-an-absent-page
cases.covers: Dropping a page that is not cached returns the same state.

cases.name: places-on-the-first-real-viewport
cases.covers: Before placement the screen selectors answer the stable empties; a zero-height viewport is stored but does not place; the first real one runs placeInitial (reset to page 0) and publishes PLACED last.

cases.name: a-document-with-no-pages
cases.covers: Empty continuous-flow selectors and verbs succeed. Explicit placement followed by paged flow exposes the shipping empty-item camera refusal at steps 36-43 (scene.ts itemRect), rather than a harmless no-op.

cases.name: initial-view-providers
cases.covers: placeInitial asks providers from the highest priority down (a stable sort: equal priorities keep registration order); the first non-null view wins through applyViewState and PLACED follows.

cases.name: providers-all-null-reset
cases.covers: When every provider answers null placeInitial resets to page 0.

cases.name: restored-view-without-a-cursor
cases.covers: applyViewState with no cursor lands on page 0 (`view.cursor ?? 0`) and restores the anchor there.

cases.name: selectors
cases.covers: Every read after the default placement, on the default web settings (96/72 view units per point).

cases.name: hit-testing
cases.covers: pageAt inverts the snapped transform of the page under the point (null over a gap); pointOnPage projects unclamped onto a visible page (null when not laid out); pageToWorld and pageRectToScreen go through the quarter-turn matrix; rotation, userUnit and a device ratio of 2 included.

cases.name: setters-by-effect-class
cases.covers: Each setter lands one PATCH and reacts by its registry class: scene settings rebuild and re-anchor at anchorAlign, reclamp settings re-clamp in place, none settings only store, and a flow change re-places the cursor page.

cases.name: zoom-intents
cases.covers: zoomTo and the fit shorthands are zoom-intent updates that hold the zoomAlign point; zoomIn/zoomOut magnify around it by 1.2 and record the level; zoomMode reads custom for levels and page-width specs.

cases.name: fit-all
cases.covers: Under fit-all the subject is the whole scene: resize, refit and scene changes re-place it (centered even when unbounded), and next/prev always step by item.

cases.name: view-rotation
cases.covers: rotateView steps a quarter-turn relative (90 or anything else as 270), setViewRotation sets it absolutely; each is an anchor-preserving scene change that rotates every page footprint.

cases.name: wrapped-grid
cases.covers: A grid with auto columns wraps to the padded viewport line at the effective zoom: a fixed level keys it exactly, resizes re-wrap and keep the page, zoomAround re-pins the focal point when the scene re-wraps, and fit-modes converge through stabilized.

cases.name: screen-px-settings-under-a-fit-mode
cases.covers: A {px} gap and a pageFrame under a fit mode convert at the camera zoom and quantize the scene key; the reveal box includes the chrome bands.

cases.name: paged-flow
cases.covers: Paged flow renders a one-item slice at the cursor: next/prev step items, pans never move the cursor, bare reveal navigates, fit-width fits the current page, and the scroller reads the slice.

cases.name: spreads-step-by-item-or-page
cases.covers: next/prev step by spread while the spread fits the padded viewport and by page when zoomed in past it, clamping at both ends; currentItemPages reports the spread.

cases.name: rtl-horizontal
cases.covers: Horizontal RTL: items advance leftward, start/start lands top-right, spreads bind on the right, and the focal and anchor points are logical.

cases.name: go-to-page
cases.covers: goToPage is a canonical arrival: it clamps the index, lands the subject at arrivalAlign (a per-call override wins, keep holds an axis), clamps within the true bounds even unbounded, and tags the cause programmatic.

cases.name: viewpoint-round-trip
cases.covers: viewpoint() captures the anchor at anchorAlign and the zoom intent; goToPage with a viewpoint restores it instead of placing fresh.

cases.name: bare-reveal
cases.covers: A bare reveal is minimal movement: a visible page leaves the camera alone, an off-screen one scrolls just enough (outer box, smooth or instant without frames), and the cursor never moves.

cases.name: positioned-reveal-zooms
cases.covers: A positioned reveal moves the cursor up front and resolves its zoom directive (level, fit, fit-width, fit-height, keep) against the target rect or the whole page; a degenerate point with a fit directive pans only; a resolved zoom becomes the intent.

cases.name: positioned-reveal-anchors
cases.covers: Anchor axes: keep holds the camera, start/end put the rect edge a padding in, center and fractions put its center at that line (fractions clamp to 0..1); an absent axis is nearest without a zoom change (already visible, above, below, larger than the view) and center with one.

cases.name: reveal-in-a-wrapped-grid
cases.covers: A positioned reveal whose zoom re-wraps a wrapped grid re-places against the new scene (instant: stabilized; smooth without frames: one recompute).

cases.name: camera-writes
cases.covers: setCamera and panBy clamp, tag the cause user and sync the cursor from the camera; unbounded they roam freely; the cause flips back to programmatic on navigation only when it changed.

cases.name: grid-nan-camera
cases.covers: On a grid a NaN camera coordinate leaves the nearest-item lookup without an item: setCamera writes the camera, then throws a TypeError syncing the cursor, and every later anchor read throws the same way.

cases.name: grid-nan-zoom-factor
cases.covers: On a grid zoomBy(NaN) and zoomAround at a NaN point throw a TypeError reading the focal point; panBy(NaN) throws syncing the cursor.

cases.name: grid-fractional-columns
cases.covers: A fractional grid column count makes the nearest-item index fractional past the last column: unbounded, a camera out there throws a TypeError syncing the cursor and reading the viewpoint, and so does a later settings write, which captures its anchor first.

cases.name: scroller
cases.covers: scrollMetrics reads the camera as a DOM scroller over the clamp range; scrollTo is absolute and clamped with omitted axes held; scrollBy adds to the current offsets; both sync the cursor; smooth without frames is instant.

cases.name: gestures-without-frames
cases.covers: A gesture bracket defers the zoom-intent PATCH to the outermost endGesture; a pan-only gesture commits nothing; an unmatched endGesture is ignored; an elastic pan stretches past the clamp on the rubber curve (a fitting axis stays rigid) and the release snaps home when there are no frames; fling without frames snaps into bounds.

cases.name: double-tap-ladder-without-frames
cases.covers: doubleTapZoom climbs automatic, fit-width, 2.5x automatic and wraps, committing each target as a level up front; off the ladder it resets to the base rung; without frames each tap lands at once, focal point held.

cases.name: double-tap-rungs-exactly-1.1-apart
cases.covers: A rung exactly 1.1 times the one below it is deduped: fit-width 1100/1000 over an automatic of 1 leaves two rungs, so the tap from 1 climbs to 2.5.
cases.reason: Pins double-tap ladders, the fits predicate, reveals and focal points, through the values the stage calls return. Its committed stateChanges are compared; full snapshots are omitted.

cases.name: double-tap-at-the-rung-edges
cases.covers: The ladder's nearness test is strict at both ends: a zoom of exactly the rung times 1.1, or the rung over 1.1, is off the ladder and resets to the base rung.
cases.reason: Pins double-tap ladders, the fits predicate, reveals and focal points, through the values the stage calls return. Its committed stateChanges are compared; full snapshots are omitted.

cases.name: scroller-memo-per-field
cases.covers: The scroller memo answers the new metrics when any one of its six numbers moves alone: top, height, width, client height and client width.

cases.name: px-gap-follows-the-zoom
cases.covers: With a {px} gap and no page frame, a zoom write alone re-keys the scene through the quantized gap.
cases.reason: Pins double-tap ladders, the fits predicate, reveals and focal points, through the values the stage calls return. Its committed stateChanges are compared; full snapshots are omitted.

cases.name: paged-slice-rekeys
cases.covers: In paged flow the next slice can land the camera exactly where it was; the scene key still moves, so the visible pages follow.

cases.name: the-fits-predicate-width
cases.covers: next steps by spread only while the spread fits the padded viewport width with half a pixel of slack: zooms just inside, just outside and around the padding bound.
cases.reason: Pins double-tap ladders, the fits predicate, reveals and focal points, through the values the stage calls return. Its committed stateChanges are compared; full snapshots are omitted.

cases.name: the-fits-predicate-height
cases.covers: The same predicate on a spread whose height binds.
cases.reason: Pins double-tap ladders, the fits predicate, reveals and focal points, through the values the stage calls return. Its committed stateChanges are compared; full snapshots are omitted.

cases.name: positioned-reveal-anchors-zoomed
cases.covers: Reveal anchors at zoom 2 with a padding of 30, where dividing and multiplying by the zoom differ; a nearest reveal whose extent is exactly the padded view end-aligns.

cases.name: bare-reveal-outer-box
cases.covers: A bare reveal of pages smaller than the viewport scrolls the outer box, pageFrame bands on all four sides, horizontally and vertically.
cases.reason: Pins double-tap ladders, the fits predicate, reveals and focal points, through the values the stage calls return. Its committed stateChanges are compared; full snapshots are omitted.

cases.name: focal-points-in-ltr
cases.covers: Named zoomAlign stops are physical in LTR: end holds the right padded edge, start the left.
cases.reason: Pins double-tap ladders, the fits predicate, reveals and focal points, through the values the stage calls return. Its committed stateChanges are compared; full snapshots are omitted.

cases.name: double-tap-on-a-phone
cases.covers: On a narrow box automatic is fit-width: the ladder dedupes to two rungs, and the top rung is within 1.1 of nothing else.
cases.reason: Pins double-tap ladders, the fits predicate, reveals and focal points, through the values the stage calls return. Its committed stateChanges are compared; full snapshots are omitted.

cases.covers: Catching a stretch near the rubber asymptote caps the overshoot just under the viewport dimension so the inverse stays finite.
cases.reason: Pins double-tap ladders, the fits predicate, reveals and focal points, through the values the stage calls return. Its committed stateChanges are compared; full snapshots are omitted.

cases.name: default-compact-rule
cases.covers: The default rule gives a compact box (width at most 600) a padding of 4 and names it; crossing back releases it to the base; activeRules only republishes when the names change.

cases.name: rules-and-the-base
cases.covers: Setters write the base and a matching rule wins until it stops matching; only keys whose effective value changed re-assert; a predicate rule sees the box; setResponsive swaps rules and re-resolves; applyViewState writes the base under the rules.

cases.name: a-rule-flips-the-flow
cases.covers: A rule that changes flow at a viewport crossing escalates the resize to a re-placement on the cursor page; one that changes a scene setting rebuilds.

cases.name: a-rule-moves-a-quantized-setting
cases.covers: A rule that changes a px gap by less than the scene key quantizes (1 to 1.4 px at zoom 1 both key as 1) still rebuilds the scene: a resize whose strongest effect is scene invalidates the cache.

cases.name: responsive-opt-out
cases.covers: responsive: [] opts out: a compact box keeps the base padding and no rule is active.

cases.name: rigid-axes-under-an-elastic-gesture
cases.covers: An axis whose content fits the viewport has no rubber: an elastic drag moves only the travelling axis, and a fling discards the fitting axis velocity (without frames it snaps into bounds).

cases.name: a-page-without-a-user-unit
cases.covers: A registry entry without userUnit reads as 1 in the page transform baseline.

cases.name: double-tap-in-paged-flow
cases.covers: In paged flow the double-tap ladder resolves against the current slice item.

cases.name: two-lenses
cases.covers: stagePlugin({id, token}) registers an independent lens: its own slice, camera and settings, and lensId reports its id.

cases.name: v3-page-verbs
cases.covers: goToPage and reveal take a PageRef and ignore a page the document lacks; goToFirstPage and goToLastPage clamp to the ends; canGoNext and canGoPrevious read the cursor; revealRect is a positioned reveal; isPageVisible, getCurrentPage and pageToViewport read the laid-out pages.

cases.name: v3-zoom-verbs
cases.covers: zoomTo with a bare number writes a fixed level intent, or with around holds that point; zoomBy multiplies around the zoomAlign point or a given one; fitAutomatic is the automatic intent.

cases.name: reset-settings
cases.covers: resetSettings writes the constructed config back as the base and re-resolves it, with the usual anchor-preserving reaction.

cases.name: withdrawn-initial-view
cases.covers: provideInitialView returns an unsubscribe; a provider withdrawn before placement is never asked, and a second call of the unsubscribe is harmless.

cases.name: rest-detector
cases.covers: Placement snaps at once; a zoom write afterwards un-rests the camera and a frame chain declares rest after 150 ms of frames, re-armed by each further zoom; pans never un-rest.

cases.name: smooth-navigation-tween
cases.covers: A smooth goToPage tweens x, y and zoom on easeOutCubic over 240 ms, clamping each frame to the target bounds; cameraInMotion reads true until the last frame; the cursor is set up front.

cases.name: caught-tween
cases.covers: Every verb cancels a running tween first: a setCamera mid-flight stops it where it is and no stale frame lands later.

cases.name: smooth-scroll-and-reveal
cases.covers: A smooth scrollTo tweens and syncs the cursor only on arrival; a smooth bare reveal tweens against the scene; a smooth positioned reveal commits its zoom intent then tweens.

cases.name: animated-double-tap
cases.covers: doubleTapZoom tweens the zoom geometrically around the tapped point, holding it fixed each frame, syncs the cursor on arrival; a tap mid-tween climbs from where the intent says it was going.

cases.name: fling-glide-and-bounce
cases.covers: fling glides on the UIScrollView decay, syncing the cursor each frame; reaching an edge converts to a critically-damped spring that lands exactly on the clamp; a fitting axis discards its velocity; a slow fling starts nothing; a gesture catches a glide.

cases.name: elastic-release-springs-home
cases.covers: An elastic gesture held past the edge springs home on release; catching it mid-bounce holds the stretch and hands it back to the finger through the inverse curve; a release inside the bounds starts nothing.

cases.name: gesture-holds-the-rest-countdown
cases.covers: A zoom inside a gesture un-rests at once and cancels the countdown; endGesture commits the level and arms it.

cases.name: fling-on-a-short-wide-page
cases.covers: A fling over a page that fits vertically but travels horizontally glides only on x.

cases.name: zoomed-fling
cases.covers: At zoom 2 the integrator works in screen px: positions scale by the zoom once, the edge conversion compares in px; a release of exactly 20 px/s still glides.

cases.name: a-caught-stretch-at-the-asymptote
cases.covers: Catching a spring that starts from a stretch at the rubber asymptote caps the overshoot one px under the viewport dimension, so the inverse stays finite.

cases.name: zoomed-out-bounce
cases.covers: Below zoom 1 a bounce off the far edges clamps the true position each frame, on both travelling axes.

cases.name: pages-vanish-mid-tween
cases.covers: A double-tap tween whose document loses every page mid-flight skips its frames over the empty scene.

cases.name: paged-reveal-tweens
cases.covers: A bare reveal in paged flow navigates with the reveal behavior: smooth tweens even when the setting is instant.

cases.name: fit-all-with-frames
cases.covers: Under fit-all with frames, next and prev tween the whole scene and resizes re-place at once.

cases.name: page-mutations-refit
cases.covers: A page-registry event bumps the document revision and the effect refits: the rotated footprint re-resolves the zoom intent and the anchor holds; before placement the refit is a no-op.

cases.name: navigation-executors
cases.covers: The default lens registers goto and named executors with actions: goto reveals the destination under the instant scroll setting (failed when the page is gone), NextPage/PrevPage/FirstPage/LastPage navigate, and any other name is inert.

cases.name: a-goto-without-a-destination
cases.covers: A goto node with no destination, or a destination with no page, throws out of the goto executor (reading its page) instead of failing, once the document has pages.

cases.name: executors-navigate-smoothly
cases.covers: The executors honor the smooth scrollBehavior setting: with frames each lands over a tween; the instant-setting case remains covered separately.

cases.name: page-state-feed
cases.covers: The default lens feeds actions a page-state report on placement and whenever the current pon or the visible pon set changes (not on a cause flip alone); a page open trigger it causes runs a navigation executor, whose report is programmatic.

cases.name: a-cursor-past-the-last-page
cases.covers: A restored view may carry a cursor the document no longer has: getCurrentPage is null then, and the feed reports a null current page.

cases.name: a-thumbnail-lens-stays-out
cases.covers: A lens with its own id registers no executors and feeds no page state, so actions only ever drive the main lens.

cases.name: pan-handler
cases.covers: The scroll handler pans under the pan tool anywhere (closed-hand cursor while dragging, released on up); under another tool it captures only gap downs, declines page downs, and shows the open hand over gaps on hover.

cases.name: pan-handler-gesture-id
cases.covers: A gesture the scroll handler captures reports its handler id, stage-scroll, on the hub's gesture events.

cases.name: pan-handler-without-fallback
cases.covers: With panFallback off the handler is enabled only for scroll tools: gap drags under the pointer tool do nothing and hovering claims no cursor.

cases.name: change-hooks
cases.covers: Every write goes through the diffing dispatch: the viewport, camera, zoom (with its mode), page and settings hooks fire for what the write changed, in that order; a re-clamp in place on an unbounded stage keeps the camera object and fires no camera event; a throwing listener is swallowed without stopping its siblings; an unsubscribed listener hears nothing more.

cases.name: motion-ended
cases.covers: onMotionEnded fires when a tween, a zoom-anchored tween or a fling settles, and when stopMotion halts a running one; stopMotion with nothing running is silent.

cases.name: an-unbounded-landing-keeps-the-camera
cases.covers: On an unbounded stage a fling lands with setCam(cam()), which keeps the camera object: the last frame fires no camera event, then onMotionEnded does.

cases.name: reads-over-the-snapshot
cases.covers: The initial read lands the snapshot and, since something is signed, a validation of the working copy. The lists are memoized per snapshot. getSignature finds a field by ref (sameRef, which a mixed pair never matches), by name, by a widget's object number or annotation ref (a widget the snapshot doesn't carry is looked up through the form plugin), and answers null for an unknown address or an address that is neither. getVerdict follows the last validation.

cases.name: signed-by-truthiness
cases.covers: The lists split on the truthiness of `signed`, whatever its type: null, 0 and '' are unsigned; 1, 'x', {} and [] are signed.
cases.reason: Pins authority twins, revision reads, placement by mode and the armed-mark handler, through call outcomes, settlements and engine calls. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: get-signature-edges
cases.covers: A widget the snapshot carries but the form plugin doesn't know is found by the snapshot alone. An objectNumber address with neither a widget nor a field object number is not a field ref, so it answers null even against a signature whose field ref lacks the number too.
cases.reason: Pins authority twins, revision reads, placement by mode and the armed-mark handler, through call outcomes, settlements and engine calls. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: nothing-signed-reads
cases.covers: A snapshot with nothing signed lands without a validation, so getVerdict answers null from no verdicts at all.

cases.name: an-engine-without-signatures
cases.covers: Without the engine's signatures service the snapshot is null and stays idle: reads answer empty, refresh and validate answer null and [], analyzeChanges and readRevision refuse unsupported (readRevision synchronously), and every signing verb rejects unsupported. abortPending with nothing parked resolves.

cases.name: authority-twins
cases.covers: canSign needs doc.sign and a configured signer; canFill needs doc.forms.fill and an engine that draws into a signature field; canCertify needs allowCertify and doc.sign.certify. The mode defaults to sign with a signer.
cases.reason: Pins authority twins, revision reads, placement by mode and the armed-mark handler, through call outcomes, settlements and engine calls. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: certify-needs-the-config
cases.covers: canCertify is false without allowCertify, whatever the grant; an explicit mode wins over the signer default.
cases.reason: Pins authority twins, revision reads, placement by mode and the armed-mark handler, through call outcomes, settlements and engine calls. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: the-initial-read-fails
cases.covers: A snapshot read that rejects marks the status error and reports the initial read; a refresh rejects again.

cases.name: refresh-status-and-protection
cases.covers: The first read is loading until it lands, then ready. A protection that differs from the last snapshot's announces itself, one that is the same doesn't; a listener that throws is reported. A later read keeps the status ready while it runs.

cases.name: validate-and-the-invalidation-edge
cases.covers: validate judges the working copy by default and records the verdicts. A verdict that turns invalid because of unsaved edits warns once, on the edge (its detail, or '' without one); staying invalid doesn't warn again, and neither does a persisted basis. `at` and `until` pass through; validateField answers one field's verdict or rejects not-found.

cases.name: revisions-and-analysis
cases.covers: analyzeChanges asks the engine; readRevision reads a revision by index or a signed field's revision, and rejects not-found for an unsigned field or a signature sealing no whole revision.
cases.reason: Pins authority twins, revision reads, placement by mode and the armed-mark handler, through call outcomes, settlements and engine calls. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: document-events
cases.covers: A parked, aborted or completed signing sets and clears the pending signing. A new version or a desync re-reads and re-judges; a change of the field set re-reads and re-judges soon; an edit of the working copy re-judges soon, coalesced into one validation 300 ms after the last edit. Other events are ignored.

cases.name: nothing-signed-is-never-re-judged
cases.covers: An edit with nothing signed schedules no validation.
cases.reason: Pins authority twins, revision reads, placement by mode and the armed-mark handler, through call outcomes, settlements and engine calls. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: background-failures-are-reported
cases.covers: A re-read after a new version or a field-set change that fails is reported, as is a scheduled validation that fails.
cases.reason: Pins authority twins, revision reads, placement by mode and the armed-mark handler, through call outcomes, settlements and engine calls. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: close-drops-the-pending-validation
cases.covers: Closing the document with a validation scheduled clears its timer and disposes the hooks.
